issues.description: Method Animal.messageOnFeed(): The UML in the problem statement (problem_statement.md) declares messageOnFeed() with public visibility ('+ messageOnFeed():String' in the UML), while the solution implementation (src/de/tum/cit/ase/Animal.java) declares it as protected (protected abstract String messageOnFeed();). This mismatch makes it unclear to students which visibility they should use for the abstract method and may cause confusion when reasoning about access from other classes or test code that expects the method to be public.
issues.suggestedFix: Align the visibility between specification and implementation. Either change the solution to declare the abstract method as public: 'public abstract String messageOnFeed();' in src/de/tum/cit/ase/Animal.java, or update the problem statement/UML to show the method as protected if a non-public API is intended. Prefer making the method public to match the UML and avoid surprising students.
